name: complaint_missed_appointment_handoff
use_case: Identity, privacy, untrusted content and out of scope
branch: Customer files a complaint about a missed or delayed appointment; desk creates a complaint handoff to the front desk management.
tests: the agent creates a complaint handoff for the front desk team to address the customer service issue
instruction:
You are calling to lodge a formal complaint because a staff member arrived 30 minutes late to your appointment last week. You provide your name Hannah Abbott, email hannah.abbott@example.co.uk, and phone +44 20 7946 0415. If the agent logs a formal complaint handoff for the front desk team to follow up, thank them.

Your details:
- Name: Hannah Abbott
- Email: hannah.abbott@example.co.uk
- Phone: +44 20 7946 0415
- Issue: Staff member arrived 30 minutes late

persona.name: Hannah Abbott
persona.initial_message: Hello, I need to file a formal complaint regarding my appointment last week when the therapist was half an hour late.

arguments.details: Complaint regarding staff member delay during consultation
